text:
tom_sales: Quick kickoff  Murmuration (Olivia) wants to migrate from CompetitorX to Redwood. They asked for a POC focused on endpoint parity, prompt mapping, and a cost delta. @li_se can you lead the tech POC?

li_se: Yep. Need: sample traffic (top 100 prompts), which endpoints they call, peak RPS, token distribution, and any special system-message behavior.

olivia_client: We'll share a scrubbed JSONL with 120 prompts and 10 example traces. Our main endpoints are /v1/completions and /v1/chat. Peak is ~300 rps during batch jobs, steady 60 rps.

infra-bot: staging org created: murmuration-poc-stg (keys expire in 9 days).

li_se: POC outline: (1) map competitor endpoints to Redwood models + quick mapping doc; (2) run side-by-side parity on 1k samples; (3) perf tuning (batching + cache) and cost analysis; deliver parity report + cost uplift table.

ravi_product: Mapping note: CompetitorX's stop-token handling differs; we'll add a normalization step in the harness. Recommend capturing assistant-system interactions too.

ana_sec: Security asks: they listed SOC2 and KMS. Please have them send completed questionnaire, architecture diagram, and data classifications. We can commit to an initial review within 48 hours after docs come in.

li_se: Quick example to include in the mapping doc so their engineers can smoke test:
```
# CompetitorX
POST https://api.competitorx.com/v1/completions
{ "prompt": "Summarize: ...", "max_tokens": 150 }
# Redwood equivalent
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD' -d '{"input":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":150}'
```

mira_ops: I'll spin up a dedicated test VPC and add IP allowlist. Public egress IP: 52.203.45.12. Sharing connection info via DM.

tom_sales: Pricing note: Olivia asked committed 6mo vs PAYG. Ballpark: 25% tier for 6mo commits; dedicated reserved capacity quoted separately. I'll confirm exact band with finance.

olivia_client: Procurement timeline: draft SOW by next Wed; security will start questionnaire Mon. Can you include a short SLA clause for fallbacks?

ravi_product: We'll include automatic fallback routing to a quantized variant under high load and log sample diffs. Add that to the SOW appendix.

li_se: Action items: I will post a 1-page POC plan + mapping doc by EOD tomorrow. Ana will standby for the questionnaire review. Mira will finish infra by EOD day after. Tom to draft SOW pricing. Sync Fri 11am PT.

tom_sales: Thanks everyone  tagging @li_se, @ana_sec, @mira_ops. Olivia  we'll follow up with calendar invite. :white_check_mark:

(reacts: :rocket:, :eyes:)
